thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 13/23-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 119-day SMA regime filter on CSCO, LRCX, CRM, AMAT, VUG, INTU, AAPL, ADBE, KLAC, with a 7% stop, a 34% target and a 102-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(119) and ema(13) crosses_above ema(23)
